title: The normalized scalar counit commutes with shifts and scalar extension is triangulated
statement:
For any normalized scalar model s on a scheme X [def-sp-finite-free-direct-image-data] and any morphism a:R to S of coefficient ring sheaves, its universal scalar counit commutes with all integer shifts and its left-derived scalar extension is triangulated for precisely the left shift induced from actual restriction.

theorem finiteFreeDirectImageScalarShift {X : Scheme.{u}} (s : ScalarModel X)
    {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : R ⟶ S) :
    (s.presentation a).derived.IsTriangulated ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (s.presentation a).counit ℤ

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A6; derived.tex Tag 0A8D, scalar adjunction and its canonical shifts.

proof.text: Form the inverse mate of exact restriction's derived factorization under the ordinary homotopy and specified derived scalar adjunctions. Their units and counits commute with their compatible shifts, so the inverse mate does too. On a flat-term K-flat complex, the unit normalization identifies its adjoint with that of the universal scalar counit; injectivity of the adjunction bijection proves equality there.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A6; computation on resolving complexes.

proof.text: Resolve an arbitrary complex by a K-flat complex with flat terms. The localized resolution and its image under scalar extension are invertible. Naturality then extends equality of the inverse mate and universal counit to every homotopy object. Thus the counit is shift-compatible. Actual derived restriction is triangulated because restriction is exact; apply Mathlib Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint with the induced compatible left shift.
